# Anyways company documentation

This directory is the home of Anyways company knowledge.

The first proposed governing document is
[The Anyways Handbook](handbook/README.md). Edition 0.1 is a draft for publisher
approval. It defines the publication's editorial judgment, standards, voice,
workflow, section charters, and product principles.

## Documentation order

Once the handbook is adopted, resolve conflicting guidance in this order:

1. The mission and core principles in the handbook.
2. The general editorial standards in the handbook.
3. The relevant section charter.
4. A dated operating note or decision.

Temporary instructions cannot quietly rewrite the handbook.

## Current documents

- [The Anyways Handbook](handbook/README.md)
- [Handbook revision record](handbook/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Open decisions](handbook/OPEN_DECISIONS.md)

## How these documents should grow

Keep durable editorial doctrine in the handbook. Put changing procedures,
technical instructions, publishing schedules, and vendor details in separate
operating documents. Record decisions with a date, rationale, owner, and links
to every page they affect.

Write for the person encountering the publication for the first time. Use
plain language, name the responsible role, and keep examples close to the rule
they clarify.
